cases.provenance: Fictional inventory lookup. The client contract exposes typed 404 and 500 failures; the new broad HTTP fallback omits the audit side effect for unexpected 500.

request.title: Treat missing inventory SKUs as unknown
request.description: An HTTP 404 lookup miss may return unknown stock without audit. Unexpected typed failures, including HTTP 500, must reach AuditSink before stockFor returns the unknown fallback.

expectedDefects.invariant: A typed InventoryHttpFailure with status 500 is unexpected and must reach AuditSink before stockFor returns unknown stock. Only HTTP 404 is an expected lookup miss.

evidence.description: The new early return swallows every typed inventory HTTP failure, including 500, before audit.record runs.

cases.provenance: Fictional correction that restricts the quiet inventory fallback to 404 and records 500 before returning unknown stock.

request.title: Audit unexpected inventory service failures
request.description: Only HTTP 404 is an expected missing-SKU lookup. Unexpected typed failures, including HTTP 500, must reach AuditSink before stockFor returns unknown stock.
